editorial:
Imagine trying to start over after a huge loss by bringing two kids into your home, only to realize they are not what they seem. You follow Lola and Adolfo, a couple who adopt Tin and Tina, two albino siblings who look sweet at first. The kids have a very strict religious background and take every single word of the Bible literally. This creates a creepy vibe right away because you know that taking old laws literally usually leads to trouble. It starts as a slow burn, but you quickly feel the tension building as the kids start acting strange in the house.

The acting is top-notch, especially the kids who make you feel uneasy without even saying much. The twists are wild and will definitely keep you guessing until the end. While some parts might feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you love movies that mess with your head, you should check this out. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the kids are not actually innocent; they are dangerous and manipulate everyone around them. In the final scenes, the violence peaks as the kids use their twisted beliefs to justify their actions. Lola ends up in a desperate fight for survival. The movie wraps up with a shocking realization that the cycle of pain continues, leaving you with a cold feeling as the kids win in their own sick way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy kids and unexpected plot twists.
